summary: Offered for sale is this well proportioned three bedroom mid terrace property, ideally suited to first time buyers or investors.
description:
LIVING ROOMS Two reception rooms leading into one another, providing flexible living and dining space.

KITCHEN Spacious kitchen with fitted wall and base units, rear door provides access to the rear yard.

BEDROOM A generously sized double bedroom offering ample space for a double bed and additional furniture. Benefiting from a window providing natural light, the room presents an excellent opportunity for buyers to update and personalise to their own taste.

BEDROOM A well proportioned second bedroom offering versatile accommodation, suitable as a double bedroom or guest room.

BEDROOM A good sized single bedroom with a window providing natural light. Offering versatile accommodation, the room would be ideal as a child's bedroom, nursery, dressing room or home office.

BATHROOM Comprising of panelled bath, low level WC and sink basin.
